name: block_credit_card
description: Blocks one of the customer's credit cards immediately so it can't be charged again. Call it as soon as a card should be blocked: the app asks the customer to confirm with Yes/No buttons before it runs, so don't ask in text first. Can't be undone through this assistant. Returns JSON with 'card_last4', 'status' and 'already_blocked' (true when the card was already blocked; that is not an error).

customer_id.description: The authenticated customer's id from get_session_context.

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card, from list_credit_cards.

customer_confirmed.description: Must be true: the customer explicitly said yes to blocking this card.
